header: The clean answer first (my standing rule, 26 Oct 2026, step 57b; extended to holiday and health check-up answers in step 61a): for every kind of question the ONE clean, to-the-point answer stands at the top as a single big bold statement (a green Yes, a red No, or the value asked for); related data comes after; long explanations are folded away. The hospital card has had its headline since step 57b; this is the same thing for the other answers. The backend payload and the screen share this type (AnalyticsPayload.headline, AnalyticsAnswer.headline).

symbols.name: HEADLINE_CLASS
symbols.sig: const HEADLINE_CLASS: Record<HeadlineTone, string> = { yes: "text-green-600", no: "text-red-600", info: "text-neutral-900", unknown: "text-amber-600", }
doc: The colours are the same as the hospital card's headline.

symbols.name: afterVerdict
symbols.sig: export function afterVerdict(text: string | undefined | null): string
doc: Under a Yes or No headline I do not repeat the word in the sentence: "Yes — 23 October 2025 is a holiday." -> "23 October 2025 is a holiday."; "No, 5 July 2026 is not a holiday." -> "5 July 2026 is not a holiday."

behaviours: 'Yes — 23 October 2025 is a holiday.' -> '23 October 2025 is a holiday.'
'No, 5 July 2026 is not a holiday.' -> '5 July 2026 is not a holiday.'
a sentence that does not start with a verdict stays as it is
'Nobody ...' and 'Yesterday ...' are not verdicts
empty, null and undefined are safe
a bare 'Yes' or 'No' is kept (nothing would be left)
tone ${tone}: text-2xl font-extrabold ${HEADLINE_CLASS[tone]}, marked data-headline="${tone}"
nothing is drawn without a headline
the text is escaped (it is plain text)
the colours are the hospital card's (so the two never drift apart)
'when is the health check-up of ticket 266288?' -> 05 Jan 2026 (the verified answer HC-5)
a ticket listed twice -> both dates, in order: '23 Dec 2024 and 26 Dec 2024' (the verified answer for ticket 205840)
'when is the health check-up of prasenjit khan?' (by name) -> the date
'which department is ticket 228757 in for the January 2026 health check-up?' -> CO & CC (BATTERY) (the verified answer HC-1)
a LIST of people ('who has the health check-up on 5 January 2026') gets no headline: it keeps its count
two different people with 'when' -> none (not one person)
not a health check-up question -> none
no rows, or no date column, or a date that is not a date -> none
a question that asks neither when nor which department -> none
OmnibarModal draws <AnswerHeadline headline={analytics.headline} /> before the count
the sentence under a Yes or No does not repeat it (lead and answer)
AnalyticsPayload (backend) and AnalyticsAnswer (screen) both carry the same headline type
the circular answer card is already ANSWER FIRST (one large key figure for a single fact): unchanged
